subject.title: fix(runtime): cancelled workflows no longer continue external commands

question: After an in-flight Gmail send completes during parent cancellation, how should Lobster preserve that definitive result while guaranteeing that no later pipeline stage executes?
rationale: The existing command and envelope contracts force a choice between returning the completed send as normal output, which permits downstream execution, and throwing cancellation, which can hide the definitive side-effect result; the permanent partial-result contract requires runtime-owner intent.

options.title: Add a halted partial-result outcome
options.body: Preserve completed send results in a cancellation-aware outcome that prevents all later pipeline stages from starting.

options.title: Surface cancellation after completion
options.body: Report the workflow as canceled after the in-flight send settles, accepting that ordinary successful output may no longer represent the completed send.

options.title: Keep the limited batch contract
options.body: Explicitly accept that cancellation only stops later drafts within this command and may not stop subsequent pipeline stages.

recommendation.title: Add a halted partial-result outcome
recommendation.body: Preserve completed send results in a cancellation-aware outcome that prevents all later pipeline stages from starting.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history is most directly connected to pipeline, resume, and workflow-result contracts needed to resolve this behavior.
